Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for offering to host us at Redwood next month. We are planning a two-person visit (Tom Bennett, Head of Platforms; myself) to see the inference stack and talk through integration patterns. Before we lock travel, two quick asks from our security/compliance team:

1) Visitor access: can you confirm whether on-campus kiosks require completed visitor forms in advance, or if we can fill on arrival? We sometimes need a pre-submitted form to get gate clearance.
2) NDA & brochure: can you send the executed NDA and any quick visitor safety notes (parking, building entrance)?

Proposed window: Dec 6 morning — ideally 9:30–11:30 for a short demo + tour. If that doesn't work, Dec 7 afternoon is also possible.

I've attached our standard visitor info form (PDF).

Thanks — Elena

Novacorp

Elena — great to hear from you. Welcome!

Short answers up front:
- Visitor forms: Redwood's north campus does permit on-arrival check-in for pre-registered visitors, but because Novacorp is bringing a device (Tom may want to demo a small appliance), we prefer pre-submission to speed security screening. If you can send the completed form, Security will issue a QR badge the morning of arrival.
- NDA: sending the signed copy now (attached).

We can host Dec 6, 9:30–11:30 — I've tentatively penciled that on our side. Lauren (ops) and Marissa (facilities) are on this thread to coordinate rooms, A/V, and parking passes.

Logistics items I'll confirm in a follow-up: parking location, building entrance, conference room name, and whether you need a private hook-up for your device. Also, do either of you have dietary restrictions for the light working lunch we'll provide?

Best,
Rishi
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
